media.title: Advantage Play on Ocean Magic by IGT | Easy Wins on Any Bet Size! | Bonus Features & How to Play

claimUnderReview: A certain number of bubbles guarantees a bonus feature and can be used as a universal advantage-play threshold.

corroboratedMechanicInstead.acceptedFact: Bubble positions on the reels are persistent per bet level.
Ocean Magic is variable-state and favorable abandoned bubble positions can create player advantage; position/state matters.

interpretation: The video remains useful for visual discovery of the Ocean Magic interface and bubble mechanic, but its bubble-count guarantee wording is not admitted as a rule, threshold or positive-EV criterion. EDGE must continue to model exact visible positions and the exact EnRacha deployment rather than a creator-supplied count heuristic.
